SETTINGS.TITLE: Fotobox Settings
SETTINGS.SHOW_PRINT_DIALOG_HINT: When disabled, photos print directly to the selected printer without a dialog.
SETTINGS.LAYOUTS_PREVIEW_HINT: Hover a layout in the list to preview it above
SETTINGS.LAYOUTS_PREVIEW_HINT_TOUCH: Tap a layout to preview; tap the preview to browse layouts
SETTINGS.GALLERY_PIN_HINT: 4 digits. Leave empty to allow open gallery access
SETTINGS.START_FAILED: The photo booth could not be started. Please check the camera (connected and switched on?) and try again.
SETTINGS.USE_SHARE: Let guests download photos via QR code
SETTINGS.SHARE_BASE_URL_HINT: Usually leave empty. Only change if auto-detection is wrong. Phones and photobox must be on the same Wi‑Fi.
SETTINGS.SHARE_TOKEN_EXPIRY_HINT: After that, a new QR code is required.
SETTINGS.SHOW_GALLERY_BUTTON_HINT: When disabled, guests cannot open the gallery.
SETTINGS.STORE_ERROR: Settings could not be loaded or saved. Please try again.
SETTINGS.LAYOUTS_AUTO_SELECTED: No layout was selected – "Einzelbild" (single photo) was enabled automatically.
SETTINGS.OPERATOR_PIN_HINT: 4 digits. Protects the settings from guests. Leave empty for open access
SETTINGS.AUTO_START: Open the Fotobox directly on startup
SETTINGS.AUTO_START_HINT: After a restart the booth goes straight to the Fotobox. The settings are then reached via the hidden top-left corner (tap 5 times).
SETTINGS.EXIT_TO_WINDOWS_HINT: For maintenance on the computer. The Fotobox restarts automatically after 30 minutes.
SETTINGS.EXIT_TO_WINDOWS_ERROR: Switching to Windows failed. Please try again.

SPLASH.API_UNAVAILABLE: The photo booth software is not responding. Please check that the Fotobox app is running and try again.

SINGLE.PROMPT: Touch the screen to take a photo

COLLAGE.START_ERROR: Could not start collage. Check template settings.
COLLAGE.ADD_PHOTO_ERROR: Could not add photo to collage.
COLLAGE.FINALIZE_ERROR: The collage could not be created.
COLLAGE.FINALIZE_ERROR_HINT: Your photos are saved. Try again or start a new collage.

GALLERY.TITLE: Gallery
GALLERY.EMPTY_HINT: Photos appear here as soon as they are taken.
GALLERY.LOAD_ERROR_HINT: Please try again in a moment.
GALLERY.DELETE_ERROR: The photo could not be deleted.

PRINT.ERROR: Printing did not work. Please ask the photo booth team to check printer and paper.
PRINT.STARTED: Your photo is printing – just a moment.

SHARE.TITLE: Share photo
SHARE.SCAN_HINT: Scan the QR code with your phone to download the photo
SHARE.ERROR: The QR code could not be created right now. Please try again.

RECOVERY.TITLE: Oops, something went wrong
RECOVERY.NETWORK_DEGRADED: Connection to the photo booth lost – reconnecting automatically.
RECOVERY.MESSAGE: The photo booth needs a quick restart. Your photos are kept.

CAPTURE.TIMEOUT: The camera is not responding right now. Please try again.
CAPTURE.FAILED: The photo could not be taken. Please try again.

LIVE_VIEW.ERROR_HINT: Please ask the photo booth team for help.

EXIT_KIOSK.TITLE: Switch to Windows?
EXIT_KIOSK.MAINTENANCE: The Fotobox closes for 30 minutes of maintenance and then restarts automatically.
